def bresenham(px, py, qx, qy):
    """Bresenham line from (px,py) to (qx,qy), return list of (x,y) points"""
    points = []
    x, y = px, py
    dx = abs(qx - x)
    dy = abs(qy - y)
    sx = 1 if x < qx else -1
    sy = 1 if y < qy else -1
    err = dx - dy
    
    while True:
        points.append((x, y))
        if x == qx and y == qy:
            break
        e2 = 2 * err
        if e2 > -dy:
            err -= dy
            if sx != 0:
                x += sx
        if e2 < dx:
            err += dx
            if sy != 0:
                y += sy
    
    return points

def bresenham_line(x0, y0, x1, y1):
    """Returns list of (x, y) on line from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1)"""
    points = []
    dx = abs(x1 - x0)
    dy = abs(y1 - y0)
    x_start, x_step = (x0, 1) if x0 < x1 else (x0, -1)
    y_start, y_step = (y0, 1) if y0 < y1 else (y0, -1)
    
    er = dx - dy
    x, y = x0, y0
    
    while True:
        points.append((x, y))
        if x == x1 and y == y1:
            break
        er2 = 2 * er
        if er2 > dy:
            x += x_step
            er = er + dy
        elif er2 < -dy:
            y += y_step
            er = er + dx
    return points
